replace_all_batch_norm_modules_: replace all batch norm modules in a PyTorch model by disabling running stats
batch_norm_without_running_stats: disable running stats on a single BatchNorm module in place
create_model_without_running_stats: create a PyTorch model with all BatchNorm layers configured without running statistics
refactor_model_batch_norm: refactor a PyTorch model to remove running mean and running var from all BatchNorm layers
test_replace_batch_norm: test the replace_all_batch_norm_modules_ function on a PyTorch module tree
